fullDescription: A loud neo-brutalist SaaS landing page on warm paper with thick black borders, hard offset shadows, an acid-yellow accent, a skewed highlighted hero headline, floating sticker chips, a logo marquee, a bento work grid, a dark feature grid, blocky pricing, and a giant CTA band.

structured.summary: Build a loud neo-brutalist SaaS marketing landing page on a warm off-white paper background with thick 3px black borders, hard offset drop-shadows, and an acid-yellow accent. Sticky bordered nav, a centered display hero with a highlighted skewed keyword block and floating tilted sticker chips, an inverted scrolling logo marquee, a bento work/showcase grid, a dark bordered feature grid, a blocky three-tier pricing row with a raised featured card, a giant acid CTA band, and a multi-column footer.

style.description: High-contrast neo-brutalist / acid-brutalist aesthetic: warm paper canvas, near-black ink, one electric acid-yellow accent plus hot-pink and sky-blue secondaries, everything outlined in heavy black borders and stacked with hard (non-blurred) offset shadows. Uppercase ultra-bold grotesk display set tight, monospaced body, wide letter-spaced micro-labels. Playful, confident, sticker-collage energy; no gradients, no soft shadows, no rounded-everything.
style.prompt: Palette: paper background #f5f3ea, ink (text/borders) #0a0a0a, primary accent acid-yellow #e8ff00, secondary hot-pink #ff5e8a, secondary sky-blue #5ec8ff, plus pure white #ffffff for inner mock surfaces. Use ink on acid, paper (#f5f3ea) on ink for inverted sections. Borders: solid #0a0a0a, mostly 3px (heavy) with 2px on smaller chips. Shadows are HARD offset blocks, never blurred: 6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a (default), 10px 10px 0 0 #0a0a0a (large/featured), 4px 4px 0 0 #0a0a0a (small), and accent variant 6px 6px 0 0 #e8ff00 on the primary nav CTA and dark cards. Fonts via Google Fonts: Archivo (display 'grotesk', weights 500-900, used uppercase ultra-bold 900 for headlines/wordmark and 800 for buttons/subheads) and JetBrains Mono (body + UI, weights 400-800) for paragraphs, labels and inputs. Type treatment: display headlines uppercase, tracking-tight, very tight line-height (~0.84-0.92); micro eyebrows/labels uppercase with wide letter-spacing 0.18em ('tracker'), 10-13px, font-weight 700. Texture: optional dotted halftone 'grain' (radial-dot pattern, ~7px tile) on a few accent blocks. Interaction language: buttons translate +2/3px and drop their shadow on hover (press-into-paper); cards swap fill/shadow color on hover. No em-dashes in copy.

layout_and_structure.description: Single long-scroll landing page, content constrained to a max-width ~1240px centered container with px-5 (mobile) / px-8 (desktop) gutters. Full-bleed section bands separated by 3px black bottom-borders; alternating paper and ink (dark) bands for rhythm. Stacking order top to bottom: sticky nav, hero, logo marquee, work grid, features grid, pricing, CTA band, footer. Responsive: nav links hide below lg and collapse to the CTA; hero floating chips hide on mobile; multi-column grids reflow 3->2->1; pricing featured card drops its lift on mobile; footer 5-col grid reflows to 2-col.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top header (z-50) on paper with a 3px black bottom border, 68px tall, max-w-1240 inner row space-between. Left: a 36px acid-yellow bordered square tile (3px border, 4px hard shadow) holding an asterisk icon, next to an ultra-bold Archivo-900 wordmark 'PRESSKIT'. Center (lg+ only): uppercase letter-spaced mono nav links (Work / Kit / Pricing / Log Notes) that turn hot-pink on hover. Right: a text 'Sign in' link plus a primary CTA button: ink-filled, paper text, 3px border, acid-yellow hard shadow (6px 6px 0 #e8ff00), press-in hover.

Centered hero section, ~paper, with four decorative floating sticker chips absolutely positioned at the corners (desktop only, hidden on mobile): a tilted pink square with a cursor icon, an acid circle with a '$' glyph, a sky rectangle reading '200ms' in mono, and a paper grain square, each 3px-bordered with a hard shadow and slight rotation. Centered stack: a small bordered status pill (paper, 2px border, hard-sm shadow, pink dot + uppercase micro-label 'SaaS website design, no design debt'); a giant uppercase Archivo-900 headline 'Ship a site' with the second line 'that sells' wrapped in an acid-yellow 3px-bordered block, slightly rotated (-1deg) with a 10px hard shadow; a mono support paragraph at max-w-xl; then a CTA row: an ink 'Start a build' button beside a bordered paper input field ('paste your app url ...') with a link icon and an arrow; a tiny uppercase mono footnote line underneath. Headline uses clamp(3rem,11vw,8.5rem).

Inverted band: ink background, paper text, 3px black bottom border, full-bleed. An infinite horizontal CSS marquee (translateX 0 to -50%, ~26s linear loop, duplicated track for seamlessness) of uppercase Archivo-800 brand names separated by small acid-yellow sparkle glyphs (Loopbase, Quanta, Northpath, Cedar OS, Meridian, Hatchwork).

Paper section with section eyebrow '[ 01 - Selected work ]', a two-line uppercase Archivo-900 heading, and a small bordered 'See full reel' link. Below, a bento grid (md: 2 cols): a tall left feature card spanning 2 rows containing a framed mini app-preview mockup (ink title bar with a cube icon + path label, then an inner paper canvas with a 'New v2' acid chip, a mini uppercase headline, two mini buttons, and a 3-cell color swatch row in pink/sky/grain) plus a bottom stat row ('+38% trial signups') and an up-right arrow; an acid-yellow stat card with a giant '2.4x' number and a chart icon; and a hot-pink card with a big rotated paper circle holding a rocket icon ('Live in 5 days flat'). All cards 3px-bordered with hard shadows.

Inverted dark band (ink bg, paper text), eyebrow '[ 02 - What's in the kit ]' in acid, two-line uppercase Archivo-900 heading. A responsive 3-col (lg) / 2-col (md) / 1-col feature card grid: each card is ink with a 3px paper border and a colored hard shadow that cycles acid/sky/pink; a 48px bordered icon tile in acid/sky/pink with an mdi icon, an uppercase Archivo-800 title, and a mono description. On hover each card inverts to paper fill + ink text and swaps its shadow accent color. Six features: Design system, Conversion copy, Fast by default, A/B ready, You own the code, Living docs.

Paper section, centered eyebrow '[ 03 - Pricing ]' and two-line uppercase heading. A 3-col pricing row (reflow to 1-col), cards 3px-bordered with hard shadows: tier 1 'Page' ($2k one-off, paper card); tier 2 'Full site' ($6k one-off) is the featured card on acid-yellow with a 10px hard shadow, lifted up (-translate-y-3 on desktop) with an absolutely-positioned ink 'Most picked' bordered ribbon overlapping the top edge; tier 3 'Retainer' ($3k/month) is an inverted ink card with acid title and acid check icons. Each card: name, one-line desc, big Archivo-900 price with a small unit suffix, a check-bullet feature list (pink checks on light cards, ink on acid, acid on dark), and a full-width bordered CTA button at the bottom.

Full-bleed acid-yellow band with a 3px black bottom border, centered. A massive uppercase Archivo-900 two-line headline 'Got a great product?' at clamp(2.5rem,9vw,7rem) with very tight 0.86 line-height, a short mono support line, and one big ink CTA button ('Start a build' + arrow icon) with a hard shadow and press-in hover.

Paper footer, max-w-1240. Top: a 5-col grid (reflow to 2-col) where the brand block spans 2 cols (acid logo tile + 'PRESSKIT' wordmark, a mono description, and three 2px-bordered square social icon buttons that fill acid on hover), and four link columns (Product, Company, Legal) with uppercase micro headings and mono links that turn pink on hover. Bottom: a single ink-filled 3px-bordered bar with a hard shadow holding the copyright on the left and a small 'Original work' disclaimer on the right; stacks on mobile.

special_ui_components.prompt: Hard-shadow border buttons: 3px ink border + offset block shadow (6/6, 10/10, or 4/4 px); primary nav/dark buttons use an acid-yellow shadow (6px 6px 0 #e8ff00); hover translates the element by its shadow offset and removes the shadow (press-into-paper effect).

Floating sticker chips: small 3px-bordered tiles/circles in acid/pink/sky, each slightly rotated with a hard shadow, absolutely positioned around the hero (cursor icon, '$' coin, '200ms' tag, grain square); hidden on mobile.
Highlighted keyword block: an inline acid-yellow 3px-bordered, slightly rotated box wrapping a hero headline word, with a large hard shadow.
Bordered status / eyebrow pill: small paper pill, 2px border, hard-sm shadow, a colored dot + wide-tracked uppercase micro label.
Inverted infinite logo marquee: duplicated flex track, translateX 0 to -50% over ~26s, brand names joined by acid sparkle glyphs.
Framed app-preview mockup (not browser chrome): ink title bar with icon + path, inner paper canvas with mini hero, chips, buttons and a color swatch row.
Inverting feature cards: dark card with colored hard shadow that swaps to paper fill + ink text and a different accent shadow on hover.
Featured pricing card: lifted acid card with an overlapping ink 'Most picked' ribbon and a 10px hard shadow.
Dotted halftone 'grain' texture: radial-dot background (~7px tile) used as a fill on select accent blocks.

structured.special_notes: Stay strictly neo-brutalist: only the five named colors (paper #f5f3ea, ink #0a0a0a, acid #e8ff00, pink #ff5e8a, sky #5ec8ff) plus white inner surfaces. All shadows are HARD offset blocks (x/y offset, 0 blur, 0 spread), never soft/blurred. Borders are crisp solid black, mostly 3px. Display type is uppercase Archivo-900 set tracking-tight with very tight line-heights; body and labels are JetBrains Mono; eyebrows/labels are uppercase with 0.18em letter-spacing. Keep the press-in hover language consistent (translate by shadow offset, drop shadow). No em-dashes anywhere in copy. Section bands are full-bleed and separated by 3px black borders, alternating paper and ink for rhythm. Responsive: hide hero chips and collapse nav on mobile, reflow all multi-col grids to fewer columns, and drop the featured pricing card's lift.
